_doc: DS30 index constituent list — the 30 blue-chip trading codes that make up the DSE 30 index. Documentation snapshot only: scripts/backfill_dse_dayend.py fetches the live list every run from https://www.dse.com.bd/api/live/index-constituents?code=DS30 (the old dsebd.org/dse30_share.php page returns HTTP 410 since DSE's late-Sep-2026 site rebuild). metric_id pattern: dse_close_<CODE>.
_status: REFRESHED 2026-10-01 from the live API. Versus the 2026-05-30 list: ACMELAB, BSRMLTD, POWERGRID joined; KOHINOOR, LINDEBD, UNIQUEHRL left (DS30 rebalance). Brief-side reads are keyed by metric_id, so dropped constituents keep their historical rows; the three new constituents need a one-off backfill over the desired window (the daily job only self-heals the last 5 days).
